description: Flygplats hinderbegränsningar enligt kod 3C is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trollhättans stad. This dataset provides information on obstacle limitations for construction near Trollhättan’s airport and helipad, in compliance with international Code 3C. The limitations define the maximum allowable heights for buildings to ensure aviation safety. For new constructions, buildings must either comply with the specified height restrictions or apply for a permit to exceed them. Coverage: Trollhättans stad. The portal shows the English title as "Airport Obstacle Limitations According to Code 3C" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Trollhättans stad. Its keywords include Height restrictions, Geodata, Geospatial data, Aviation safety, Land information, Helikopterplatta. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
